title_en: In Astir, at Alba Construction, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with perfect floor plan!!!
description_en: In Astir, at Alba Construction, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with perfect floor plan!!! The apartment has a gross area of ​​120.91 m2, a net area of ​​105.48 m2 and is oriented towards the west. It is located on the 8th floor of a residential complex of 5-10 floors with 2 floors of underground parking which is under construction in the final stage of parquet/tile laying. The complex stands out for its high-quality works, starting from the hydraulic-electrical installations, thermal insulation with a capot system, paving with tiles or parquet according to the customer's wishes, thermal double-glazed windows equipped with shutters, rest areas and green spaces around the complex.
